layers.orbit: Inspection lane. Traffic is counted. You are already on a slate.
layers.atmosphere: City air inside the orbital. The keel stays outside.
layers.surface: Dock rings and lamp rows. Not a landing for this hull.
layers.crust: The city crust is closed. Ring ice sits in the band a drone can cut.
layers.biosign: People, livestock in bond, nothing wild the probe should chase.
layers.ruins: The first dock spine, still in use.
layers.legal: Helion Compact Guard. City-orbital. Not a claim. Ring ice is a surveyed cut, not a homestead.

layers.orbit: Ice band outside the city lamps. Lease markers every few degrees.
layers.atmosphere: None. Open vacuum over the chips.
layers.surface: Sintered ice, lamp-cut faces, a few old drone scars.
layers.crust: The band is thin. Under it is the city's closed stone.
layers.ruins: Survey beacons from the first lease, still blinking.

layers.orbit: A slow tumble of confiscated hulls. Tow tags still on the bows.
layers.atmosphere: None. The field is vacuum and paint flakes.
layers.crust: No crust. Hollow hulls and trapped air.
layers.biosign: None living. A few sealed lockers.

trash.name: Seized Hold
